messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security slot. A few customers asked for a single-page summary: SOC2 evidence handoff, ISO gap scope, BYOK rotation behavior, VPC/Privatelink checklist, and exact audit-log export options for Private. Who owns each and quick deadlines so Sales/CS can reply?

Ava (Security): I can own SOC2 evidence mapping + the BYOK FAQ. Plan: create a control->artifact index and a short BYOK paragraph showing staged rotation. Need Legal for wording and Platform for sample artifact manifests.

Priya (Legal): I will review control narratives and the BYOK wording. Reminder: any claim of "EU-only custody" or "KMS never leaves region" must be backed by region-scoped KMS + region-bounded export targets and a DPA amendment.

Liam (Infra): I'll draft the VPC/Privatelink checklist (CIDR guidance, privatelink endpoints, flow logs to customer buckets, private DNS). ETA: 2023457000 (Fri EOD). Will include a small terraform snippet.

Diego (Platform): Audit/export note: we support ndjson dumps to S3/GCS and streaming to customer SIEMs via a signed forwarder. Default retention proposal: 90d (full traces), 365d (metadata). For Private customers we can extend retention by contract. I'll attach CLI examples and an API sample.

Nora (Compliance): I'll consolidate ownership in the compliance workspace and add an auditor-facing README. Also propose a short checklist for auditors describing where to find evidence in our portal.

Ava (Security): Owners & deadlines: SOC2 index = Ava, draft by 2023457040 (Fri morning). BYOK FAQ = Ava, draft by 2023457400 (Mon).

Priya (Legal): Legal review: I'll review SOC2 narratives and BYOK FAQ by 2023457520 (Mon afternoon).

Diego (Platform): Audit export examples: I'll post CLI + API examples by 2023457600 (Mon evening). Example CLI snippet: ```bash
redwoodctl export-audit --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-07 --format ndjson --dest gs://customer-logs-eu/ --redact-pii
```

Liam (Infra): VPC checklist ETA: 2023457000 (Fri EOD). Sample terraform snippet I'll include: ```hcl
resource "aws_vpc" "redwood_private" {
  cidr_block = "10.20.0.0/16"
}
resource "aws_flow_log" "redwood_flow" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/private/flow"
}
```

Nora (Compliance): I'll create the auditor README and upload a template evidence packet by 2023458000 (next Wed).

Ava (Security): Retention policy proposal: 90 days for request bodies, 365 days for metadata/audit events. Enterprise can request >3y via contract addendum (privacy sign-off required).

Priya (Legal): Confirmed: retention >3 years requires Privacy approval. Also flag any export to EU-only buckets in the DPA addendum.

Jo Chen (CEO): Good. Sales also wanted a one-paragraph BYOK statement they can paste into RFPs explaining how we avoid downtime during key rotation. Ava/Priya, can you add that to the BYOK FAQ?

Ava (Security): Yup. Quick draft now: "Redwood supports staged BYOK rotation using key aliases and an overlap window; incoming requests are accepted by both old and new key aliases during validation, enabling zero-downtime rotations. Customers supply rotated keys and Redwood coordinates alias swap once validation completes." Will refine with Legal.

Diego (Platform): Small technical caveat: for HSM-backed BYOK in on-prem/private installs we need VIN and test vectors from the customer to validate PKCS#11 flows. Liam, we should add that to the VPC checklist as an ops step.

Liam (Infra): Roger. I'll add HSM/VIN prep steps and NDA note to the checklist.

ops-bot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2023456789 (SSO).

Jo Chen (CEO): Thanks all. Nora/Ava — please add owners and links in the compliance workspace and ping me if exec-level unblock needed. Can we reconvene next Tue for a 10-min status check?

Nora (Compliance): Adding workspace items now and will post links here when ready.

Ava (Security): Posting SOC2 index + BYOK draft to the workspace by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
